tickets.title: Prepare revised household budget for repayment
tickets.text: Prepare a revised household budget for Julian Mossbutton and Lena Mossbutton to support setting an accelerated debt‑repayment target, using the updated take‑home pay of $9,250 per month after Lena’s schedule change and current core spending of $7,850 per month.
tickets.evidence: the revised budget is needed before setting a target for accelerated debt repayment.

tickets.title: Estimate tax impact of selling investments
tickets.text: Estimate the tax impact of selling the appreciated holdings in Julian and Lena Mossbutton’s joint taxable investment account at Velvet Acorn Custody, valued at about $96,000, to determine how much can be used for debt reduction.
tickets.evidence: the tax impact needs to be estimated before using investments as a funding source.
